cohort: 264 women (88 cases and 176 controls) admitted to public hospitals in North Shewa Zone, Ethiopia
finding: Educational level of women and husbands, being referred from other health facilities, antenatal care visits, cesarean section, and medical disorders during pregnancy significantly increased the risk of maternal near miss, while younger age significantly decreased the risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean section significantly increased the risk of maternal near miss.
